stops.note: to seek out thoroughly, to conquer, from com- (thoroughly) and quaerere (to seek)
settled in Spanish for the soldiers and explorers who conquered the Americas
stops.meaning: a Spanish conqueror of the Americas

stops.note: popularized in English by William Prescott's histories of the conquest of Mexico (1843) and Peru
stops.meaning: a Spanish conqueror, especially of the Americas

current_meaning: a Spanish conqueror, especially one of those who conquered Mexico and Peru in the 1500s
